summary: Ran backend pytest regression plus mobile-first Expo UI checks for requested filter/edit/delete/stock-sync features. Backend passed; frontend found a blocker on inventory item selection for edit/delete flow.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping item cards (`inventory-item-*`) does not populate edit form (name/code/stock stay empty), so selectedItemId is not set and delete confirmation card never appears.
After selecting an item and pressing save, app sends create flow (POST /api/items) instead of update flow (PUT /api/items/{id}), causing 'Kode barang sudah dipakai'.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend cannot reliably enter edit state from list tap; backend item update/delete endpoints are healthy via pytest but blocked from UI path.

issues: Expo warning in logs: Image style.resizeMode is deprecated; use Image prop resizeMode.

action_items: Fix inventory item-card onPress/edit-state wiring so selecting list item always sets selectedItemId and pre-fills form.
Ensure inventory 'Simpan barang' calls update endpoint when in edit mode (PUT), not create endpoint (POST).
After fix, re-test UI flows: edit item, delete item with HAPUS confirmation, then continue full user CRUD UI regression.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py still uses fallback defaults for DB_NAME and JWT_SECRET; project rules require env-only fail-fast for config.
Frontend/base URL key uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL while project rule emphasizes EXPO_BACKEND_URL; keep naming aligned to avoid config drift.
Quick-range/status filter buttons in transactions screen lack dedicated testID hooks, making regression automation brittle.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (core transaction/filter/admin checks passed; inventory edit/delete UI blocked)

seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_/UI-prefixed items, transactions, and users through pytest and UI runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not retry inventory-delete selector immediately. First verify inventory list tap truly populates form and selectedItemId. Once fixed, continue with item delete UI and then complete user edit/delete UI end-to-end on a newly created non-seeded user.
rca_of_issue: Reproduced 3x: filtering inventory and tapping `inventory-item-*` leaves edit fields empty and delete card hidden. Backend logs show POST /api/items 400 (duplicate code) during intended edit, proving frontend remained in create mode instead of edit mode.
